 Antonelli starts fourth in Mexico City LIVE F1 Mexico Grand Prix LIVE: Race updates as Kimi Antonelli goes for the title
 Live updates from the 2026 Formula 1 Mexico City Grand Prix
 KEY MOMENTS
 Race starts at 8pm GMT
 Lewis Hamilton on pole for first time as Ferrari driver
 Antonelli can win the championship today
 The 2026 Formula 1 Mexico City Grand Prix concludes on Sunday 1 November with the 71-lap race.
 The 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix could become an historic day in F1 history, as Mercedes driver Andrea Kimi Antonelli aims to become the youngest world champion ever. 
 The Italian only needs to finish inside the top nine to guarantee he leaves Mexico as F1's newest world champion. 
 But he faces a tough afternoon. Feeling unwell, Antonelli has not been as fast as nearest title rivals Lewis Hamilton and George Russell so far this weekend. 
 Antonelli will go from fifth on the grid, while Russell starts second. 
 Lewis Hamilton scored his first pole as a Ferrari driver and his first since 2023, after a stunning final lap in Q3 to clinch top spot. Ferrari has looked strong all weekend in Mexico. 
 Charles Leclerc will start from third, while Red Bull's Max Verstappen was demoted to fourth due to a penalty for a collision with Liam Lawson in practice.
 Lawson was thrown out of the qualifying result due to a technical breach with his Racing Bulls. 
 At Haas, Ryo Hirakawa will make his F1 race debut on Sunday, after being drafted in last-minute to replace the ousted Esteban Ocon. 
 The race starts at 8pm GMT.
 Luke Newman 01 Nov 2026 20:28 Charles Leclerc continues to extend his lead and is now 4.5 seconds ahead of Max Verstappen!
 20:25 Oscar Piastri has had a strong start to the Grand Prix. The Australian driver has made five places and is currently running in seventh place, but is 6.5 seconds behind his teammate in sixth place
 20:24 Charles Leclerc currently holds a 3.8-second lead ahead of Max Verstappen... but the penalty is still looming over him
 20:23 As a reminder, both Aston Martin drivers are out of the race, and only completed 5 laps
 20:22 George Russell penalty! George Russell has now been handed a 10-second time penalty for causing a collision on the opening lap of the race!
 20:21 Charles Leclerc penalty! The race leader, Charles Leclerc, has been handed a five-second penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage at the start of the race!
 20:20 Top 5 as it stands After 11 laps of racing, here is how the top five currently look after the VSC period:
 Charles Leclerc

 20:19 George Russell under investigation The stewards are now investigating George Russell for 'causing a collision) at Turn 6 on the opening lap of the race
 20:17 Back to green! The virtual safety car is in and we are back to green flag conditions. None of the front runners pitted during that VSC, with it coming a little too early. 
 20:15 Virtual Safety Car! The virtual safety car is out on lap seven with Stroll stopping by the side of the track with a problem in his Aston Martin. 
 20:08 Hamilton and Leclerc under investigation The incident between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc at Turn 4 on the opening lap, is now under investigation
 20:07 Turn 4 Incident Noted An incident between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc at Turn 4 has been noted by the stewards 
 20:06 Sergio Perez was a fast starter at his home Grand Prix, as he made up six places, and is in 14th
 20:05 Isack Hadjar spun on the opening lap and is now at the back of the field 
 20:05 At the end of the opening lap, the top five look like this:
 Charles Leclerc
 Max Verstappen
 Lewis Hamilton
 Kimi Antonelli
 George Russell
 20:04 Charles Leclerc has quickly taken the lead away from his teammate, and Max Verstappen is into second place
 20:03 Mexico GP is underway The Mexico GP is underway, and the drivers have made the long run down to Turn 1, and it is Lewis Hamilton who grabbed the lead in the opening sector 
 20:00 Formation Lap The drivers are away from the grid for their Formation Lap...
